id.description: The entry id with ':' turned into '-', then -2, -3… when that is taken.

entry.description: The library entry that was added: <kind>:<slug>.

version.description: The entry's version when it was added.

shelf.description: The shelf it came from: the entry's `source`, which equals its shelf's name (framework, dao…).

created.description: Every record the add created, with its hash as created: how a removal tells a record edited since the add. Empty for an add that only changed what the org had (then `modified` is not).

modified.description: L7-D11: every record the add changed that the org already had. `base` is its hash before the add (a removal gives back the version with that hash, from git history); `after` its hash as the add left it (a removal asks before giving back a record whose hash is no longer `after`). Absent when the add changed nothing the org had.

by.description: Sealed: the member who applied or proposed the add. Null only while staged.

at.description: Sealed: the day it was applied or proposed (the decision row dates a ratify). Null only while staged.

removed.description: Null while installed. On removal, { by, at, decision }, sealed the same way.

record.description: <registry>:<id>, the change engine's record (an id may hold colons; no spaces).

base.description: SHA-256 of the record's canonical YAML as created (in `modified`: as it was before the add). Null only while staged.

after.description: In `modified` only: SHA-256 of the record's canonical YAML as the add left it. Null only while staged.

rule.description: The Org-Rule value of the commit.

proposal.description: The proposal that ratified it; its decision row is found by its `proposal` field.

decision.description: Sealed: a change applied directly, or a proposal ratified. Null only while staged.

$comment: data/library.yaml (DAO-OS L1, ruling L1-R1): the library's receipts. Written only through the library's Add and Remove; lib/receipts.mjs checkReceipts reports a committed receipt with a null seal. `modified` (L7-D11) holds the records an add changed that the org already had, each a recordBase with `after`.
